note: v1886: The test I wrote about a millisecond timestamp being confused for seconds pinned the real value from his budget file and asserted it survived the twenty-four hour window. It passed for a day and then failed mid-push, exactly twenty-four hours after the moment it described, and his pre-push gate refused the ship. The value is built relative to now, a mirror asserts that a genuinely old stamp still ages out so that rescaling never means resurrecting, and the class was swept: every other epoch literal in tonight tests is a reel id with no window semantics.
